pack.topic: Sloping Roof Waterproofing & Drainage in Coimbatore Residential Construction
pack.source_script_insight: The source video highlights the architectural integration of sloping roofs and monsoon management in Coimbatore homes, emphasizing how traditional tile layouts handle heavy rainfall.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Coimbatore experiences intense seasonal downpours during the Northeast and Southwest monsoons, making proper sloping roof waterproofing, flashing, and gutter alignment critical to prevent water seepage into living spaces.
pack.core_takeaway: Ensure precision slope angles, waterproof underlays, and secure tile detailing on residential roofs to protect homes against heavy monsoon rains in Coimbatore.

pack.gemini_video_prompt: Produce a high-end, photorealistic 10-second vertical video (9:16 aspect ratio) for OliveTree Builders, tailored exclusively for Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS. EXACTLY 7 SCENES. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE: 90%+ of visuals must look like real, on-site smartphone or gimbal footage shot at active residential construction sites in Coimbatore under natural daylight. NO cartoon, NO toon animation, NO 2D flat explainer graphics, NO 3D renders, NO CGI. Motion graphics are strictly limited to tiny text overlays ('Roof Slope Check', 'Waterproof Base', 'Flashing Sealing', 'Tile Alignment', 'Drainage Outlet', 'Flow Test', 'OliveTree Quality') and simple checkmark or arrow icons. Continuity rules: maintain consistent lighting, realistic dust, concrete textures, brickwork, and worker attire across all scenes. Scene 1 opens with a worker checking roof slope with a spirit level. Scene 2 shows liquid waterproofing application on a terrace slab. Scene 3 focuses on metal flashing sealing near parapet walls. Scene 4 displays masons laying terracotta tiles on a sloped concrete structure. Scene 5 shows an engineer checking a PVC drainage outlet pipe. Scene 6 depicts a water flow test running down the finished slope. Scene 7 reveals a completed residential sloped tile roof under Coimbatore daylight. NEGATIVE PROMPT: animated characters, cartoon style, flat vector graphics, white background studio setup, fake futuristic elements, landscape orientation, black bars, side-blur frames, unrealistic CGI rendering, floating text documents, random presenters.
